experiment.comment: Recommended simulation settings based on the paper: isothermal-isobaric.
T-profiles were obtained from a previous publication of the authors with the same experimental setup: https://doi.org/10.1016/j.fuel.2022.125705. Those T-profiles were used for linear interpolation.
"Standard" conditions were considered as T_0 = 273.15 K and p_0 = 1 bar.
Uncertainty of the temperature was not reported in the paper.
